content.text: Fixed. `rb_push` in `src/ringbuf.c` wrote to `data[len % cap]`, which ignores `head`, so it overwrote live elements once the buffer had wrapped. It now writes to `data[(head + len) % cap]`. `make test` now passes with 118 checks and 0 failures.
